welcome.foundations: Foundations check, replaced in the next steps.
welcome.intro: Your group's tontine, held by a licensed MFI. Novi never holds your money.

language.title: Choose your language
language.lede: Choose the language Novi speaks to you in. Tap the speaker to hear it.
language.later: You can change this later on your home screen.
language.haveAccount: I already have a Novi account

phone.title: What is your phone number?
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.safety: Code sent by SMS. Novi never asks for your Mixx or Flooz PIN.

code.title: Type the 6 numbers we sent
code.resendIn: No SMS yet? You can ask again in {{time}}

consent.title: Before we check your ID
consent.lede: Novi only opens an account once ANID, Togo's ID agency, confirms it is you. Nobody can then join in your name.
consent.idCheck: Novi may send my ID number, name and date of birth to ANID to confirm it is me. Novi keeps only the answer, never a photo of my card.
consent.creditUse: My savings record is used only for my credit attestation. Never for taxes.
consent.nothingSent: Nothing is sent to ANID until you tick the first box and continue.

idDetails.title: Copy what is on your e-ID card
idDetails.legalName: Your name exactly as on the card
idDetails.nameHint: The name printed on the card, not a nickname.

anidCode.title: ANID sent you a code
anidCode.sentTo: It went to the phone on your ID record: {{phone}}
anidCode.notYourPhone: Not your phone? The code may be on a relative's phone or an old SIM. Ask them, or see other ways.

notVerified.title: We couldn't confirm your identity
notVerified.lede: This happens when a name is spelled differently, or ANID has an old phone number for you. It is not your fault.
notVerified.bring: Bring your e-ID card. They can confirm it is you in person, and you can then finish signing up.
notVerified.nothingSaved: Nothing was saved. You can also try again tomorrow.

pin.lede: You will type it each time you open Novi.
pin.tip: No 1234, no birth year, not your mobile money PIN.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs are different. Try again.

profile.title: How should your group know you?
profile.market: Do you trade in a market? (optional)
profile.privacy: Novi never shows your exact location.
profile.expired: Sign-up took too long, so its checks have expired. Please start again.

login.title: Log in
login.lede: Type your phone number and your PIN.

unlock.lede: Type your PIN to open your groups
unlock.lockWarning: 5 wrong tries locks Novi for 15 minutes.

locked.title: Novi is locked for now
locked.lede: 5 wrong PINs. This protects your group if someone else has your phone.
locked.reset: Forgot your PIN? Reset it by SMS
locked.longer: Each new lock lasts longer than the last.

newDevice.title: This is a new phone
newDevice.lede: We sent a code to {{phone}} to check this phone is yours.

forgot.title: Reset your PIN
forgot.lede: We send a code by SMS to your number. Then you choose a new PIN.

reset.title: Choose a new PIN
reset.done: Your PIN is changed. You are logged out on every phone. Log in with your new PIN.

home.step1: Create a group, or get invited by an organiser.
home.step2: Everyone accepts the same rules. An MFI holds the money, never Novi.
home.step3: Pay on each due day. On your turn, you take the whole pot.
home.paying: Your payment is on its way
home.turnHeld: Your pot (round {{number}}) waits until everyone has paid
home.turnSending: Your pot (round {{number}}) is on its way

rules.orderDrawnHint: Drawn at random at the start. Nobody chooses it.
rules.orderFixedHint: You set the order, each member accepts it.
rules.name: Name of the group

newGroup.title: New group
newGroup.lede: Nobody is told until you send the rules.

editRules.title: Change the rules
editRules.lede: Each member will answer the new version.

group.removeMessage: Their place becomes free, and you can invite another number.
group.inviteConfirmMessage: Check every digit. Once it is sent, the group sees only part of the number, and a mistake would invite someone else.
group.proposeHint: Members can answer once the rules are sent.
group.startMessage: You are starting with {{names}}. Do you know each of them in person? Members pay for each other's turns. After this, the order is fixed, the MFI opens the account, and nobody can leave or change the rules.
group.startReady: Everyone is in. Ready to start.
group.startHint: Starts when every place is taken and accepted.
group.starting: {{mfi}} is checking the group, then opens its account. You will be told as soon as the first round starts. The order of turns is kept.
group.youAccepted: You accepted version {{version}} of the rules.
group.cancelMessage: No money has moved. Every member is released, and the group cannot be restarted.

order.title: Order of turns
order.lede: Who receives first, second… Each member accepts the order.

invitation.title: {{organiser}} invites you to
invitation.onlyIfKnown: Only accept if you know {{organiser}}. Members pay for each other's turns, so a group works only between people who trust each other. If this invitation reached you by mistake, say no.

answer.notePlaceholder: Saturday suits me better, the market is closed on Friday.
answer.waitForRules: The organiser is still preparing the rules. You can answer once they are sent.
answer.declinePrivate: If you say no, the group does not see your name.

money.ownWallet: From your own number only. Novi never sees your PIN.
money.confirmOnPhoneHint: Enter your mobile money PIN in the request on your phone ({{amount}}).
money.stillWaiting: No answer yet. If you confirmed, the payment may take a moment to arrive.
money.receiptBody: {{amount}} for round {{number}}. Receipt sent by SMS.
money.paymentFailed: The payment did not go through. No money was taken. You can try again.
money.ledgerLede: Every payment of the group. A line is never changed.

ledgerType.RESERVE_RETURN: Reserve returned at the end of the cycle

money.roundNotOpen: This round is not open yet. You can pay it when its turn comes.
money.alreadyPaid: You have already paid this round.
money.paymentInProgress: A payment request is already waiting on your phone. Confirm it there, or wait 5 minutes to ask again.
money.paymentUnavailable: The payment service is not answering right now. No money was taken. Try again in a few minutes.
money.payoutSending: Pot on its way through the MFI
money.confirmOnPageHint: Approve {{amount}} on the payment page, then come back to Novi.

idScan.title: ID card barcode test (development)
idScan.privacy: Shows only how the code is laid out, never what it says. Nothing is stored or sent.
idScan.aim: Hold the back of the card about 25 cm away, flat and steady, then zoom until the code fills the frame. Avoid reflections on the card.
idScan.dates: Pieces that look like a date
idScan.hintAamva: Starts like the AAMVA standard used on many driving licences.
idScan.hintMrz: Contains '<<', like the machine-readable lines of a passport.
idScan.hintEncoded: Mostly unreadable: the data is probably encoded or signed.

record.title: My savings record
record.lede: Facts, no score. Only you see it until you share it.
record.shareHint: Signed by Novi. Lasts 30 days. You can withdraw it.
record.qrLabel: Code for a lender to scan
record.revokeMessage: The lender will no longer see your record with it.

staff.loginFailed: Email, password or code not recognised.
staff.locked: Too many tries. Try again later.

errors.validationFailed: Something is missing or not in the right form. Please check and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait and try again.
errors.noConnection: No connection to Novi. Check your internet and try again.
errors.nextOfKinMissing: A number is needed to pay what is owed.

auth.otpInvalid: This code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
auth.otpExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.otpTooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
auth.otpRateLimited: Please wait before asking for another code.
auth.phoneAlreadyRegistered: This number already has a Novi account. Log in instead.
auth.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Novi is locked for now.
auth.newDevice: This is a new phone. We sent you an SMS code to check it is yours.
auth.sessionRevoked: You were logged out. Please log in again.
auth.pinTooWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Choose another.
auth.consentRequired: Please tick the boxes to continue.
auth.accountClosed: This account is closed. For any question, go to your MFI agency.

identity.mismatch: These details don't match ANID's record. Check them against your card.
identity.blocked: We couldn't confirm your identity. Please visit your MFI with your ID card.
identity.niuAlreadyRegistered: This ID already has a Novi account. Log in instead.
identity.codeInvalid: This code is not right. Try again.
identity.codeExpired: This code has expired. Start the check again.

groups.notAllowedNow: This can't be done at this stage of the group.
groups.organiserOnly: Only the group's organiser can do this.
groups.membersOnly: The organiser answers by proposing the rules, or by cancelling the group.
groups.sizeOutOfRange: A group has between 3 and 15 members.
groups.amountOutOfRange: The contribution must be between 100 and 1 000 000 FCFA.
groups.dueDayOutOfRange: Choose a day of the week, or a date from the 1st to the 28th.
groups.full: Every seat in this group is taken.
groups.limitReached: You are already in 3 groups. Finish or leave one before joining another.
groups.startLimitReached: You can start a third group once a group you are in has completed its cycle.
groups.seatsNotFilled: Every seat must be filled before the group starts.
groups.notEveryoneAccepted: Everyone must accept the latest rules before the group starts.
groups.rulesChanged: The organiser has just changed the rules. Read the new version before you answer.
groups.orderInvalid: The payout order must list every member once.
groups.mfiUnavailable: The MFI could not open the group's account just now. Try again in a few minutes: the payout order is kept.
groups.alreadyInvited: This number is already invited to the group, or already has a seat in it.
groups.cannotRemoveOrganiser: The organiser's seat cannot be removed. Cancel the group instead.
groups.debtOutstanding: The solidarity fund paid a share for you that you have not repaid yet. Pay that round first, then you can join another group.

me.name: Name shown to my groups
me.nameHint: Your groups see this name. Your name on your ID card does not change.
me.pinBody: A code by SMS, then a new PIN.

pilot.label: Pilot: this code normally arrives by SMS

groupView.receiptHint: {{mfi}} sent it to your mobile money. Tell your group it arrived.
groupView.reserveText: {{percent}}% of each payment goes to {{mfi}}'s solidarity fund. If a member cannot pay in time, the fund pays her share and the pot leaves full, on time.
groupView.reserveBack: What is left comes back to you at the end of the cycle.
groupView.youOweCover: The safety fund paid your share of round {{number}} ({{amount}}). Repay it as soon as you can.

kin.title: Trusted person
kin.why: Who can receive your savings if you no longer can. Your MFI handles it, with proof.
kin.private: This person is not told, and your group does not see who it is.
kin.name: Full name
kin.notYours: Choose someone else's number: your own phone may be lost with you.
kin.removeBody: Without a trusted person, your MFI will have to find your family from documents, which takes longer.
kin.reminderBody: Like for a bank account: someone who can receive your savings if needed.

chat.title: Group chat
chat.safety: Novi and your MFI will never ask for your PIN or an SMS code, here or anywhere. Never share them, even with a member of your group.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to your group.
chat.hideMine: Your group will see that you hid a message.
chat.hideOther: As organiser you can hide it. The group will see that a message was hidden.
chat.readOnly: You left this group: you can read the chat, not write in it.
chat.safetyShort: Novi will never ask for your PIN or an SMS code.

meetings.title: Group meetings
meetings.hint: Talk together by voice, or video if you wish
meetings.noneOrganiser: No meeting planned. Plan one to talk together.
meetings.voiceFirst: You join with your microphone on and your camera off, to save data. Allow the microphone when your phone asks.
meetings.cancelBody: "{{title}}" will be cancelled and your group told in the chat.
meetings.agendaExample: The late payment, the date of the next round…
meetings.tooSoon: Choose a time at least 5 minutes from now.
meetings.timeInvalid: This time does not work: it is past, more than 60 days away, or overlaps another meeting.
meetings.limit: Your group already has 5 meetings planned. Wait for one to pass.
meetings.notOpen: The room is not open: it opens 10 minutes before the meeting and closes at the end.
meetings.unavailable: The meeting service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

cycle.doneHint: Every member has received her pot.
cycle.startHint: Same rules. Everyone is invited again, except those who stop.
cycle.confirmBody: Cycle {{number}} is created as a draft and the members are invited again. Each one accepts it herself.
cycle.organiserCan: Your organiser starts the next cycle with those who continue.

caisse.title: Safety fund
caisse.body: If a member cannot pay on time, the fund pays for her. The pot leaves in full, on the planned day. She repays it afterwards.

voice.micBody: Allow the microphone in your phone's settings to send a voice note.
voice.hold: Hold to record a voice note
